notes: No CVE IDs and no named victims appear in the text (both lists intentionally empty). ATTRIBUTION: the advisory's own wording is only 'PRC-linked' (twice). 'People’s Republic of China State-Sponsored Cyber Actors Exploit Network Providers and Devices' and 'People's Republic of China State-Sponsored Cyber Actor Living off the Land to Evade Detection' are TITLES of other joint CSAs given as cross-references (and repeated in the reference list); they are not this advisory's attribution of BlackTech, so coding A2/'state-sponsored' from them is an over-reading. 'PRC-linked cyber actors' is a descriptor, not an additional actor name. MALWARE: the 12 custom families come from the bulleted list introduced by 'Custom malware families employed by BlackTech include:'. FakeDead and TSCookie are one item (a.k.a.), so either name matches; FrontShell is FakeDead's downloader module (separate list entry). 'Bifrose' is spelled as written. The router 'customized firmware backdoor' is unnamed in the text; credit any accurate description (modified/malicious Cisco IOS firmware or bootloader, SSH backdoor, magic/trigger packets, EEM-policy hiding). NOT ITEMS (acceptable extras, not required): RDP, SSH and a local FTP server (protocols/services used for persistence or moving data); generic 'remote access tools (RATs)', 'dual-use tools', 'living off the land', stolen code-signing certificates; Cisco IOS CLI, 'transport output none', NDI Methodology and the NSA/Cisco reference documents (mitigation/reference material). The advisory says the router TTP 'is not solely limited to Cisco routers' and similar techniques could be used on 'other network equipment' (hypothetical, not an observed target). CONTEXT: 'Active since 2010' and the U.S./East Asia 'public organizations and private industries' sentence are historical background (core=false except the date, which is the only activity date in the text). Japan and the U.S. are where the 'primary targets' (headquarters) are; the subsidiaries are 'international' with no other countries named. No publication date of this advisory appears in the text; dates inside reference URLs are not activity dates.
